title: Malayalam Content Writer_Kottayam
description:
**Job Description: Malayalam Content Writer** 




**Location:** 
 Ettumanoor, Kottayam, Kerala
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Salary Range:** 
 ₹20,000 \- ₹30,000 per month
 


  

**About the Role** 
  


 We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Malayalam Content Writer to produce engaging, accurate, and search\-friendly content for our digital platforms. The ideal candidate has excellent command of Malayalam, a flair for storytelling, and an understanding of how content performs online.
 


  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

* Write original Malayalam content for websites, blogs, articles, social media, ad copy, video scripts, and newsletters
* Translate and adapt English content into natural, culturally relevant Malayalam
* Research topics thoroughly and ensure factual accuracy
* Apply basic SEO practices (keywords, headings, meta descriptions) to improve search visibility
* Proofread and edit content for grammar, spelling, tone, and consistency
* Collaborate with the SEO, design, and social media teams to align content with campaign goals
* Maintain brand voice across all content
* Meet deadlines and manage multiple content requests at once
* Track content performance and suggest improvements
  


  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
  

* Bachelor's degree in Malayalam, Journalism, Mass Communication, English, or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
* 2\+ years of experience in Malayalam content writing, journalism, or digital content creation
* Excellent written Malayalam, with strong grammar, vocabulary, and spelling
* Good working knowledge of English for translation and research
* Familiarity with Malayalam typing tools (Unicode, Google Input Tools, etc.)
* Basic understanding of SEO and content marketing
* Strong research, editing, and proofreading skills
* Ability to write in different tones (informative, conversational, promotional)
  


  

**Preferred Skills** 
  

* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms
* Knowledge of keyword research tools (Google Keyword Planner, Ubersuggest, etc.)
* Experience writing scripts for YouTube or Reels
* Basic familiarity with AI writing tools, with the ability to edit and humanize output
* A portfolio of published Malayalam work

title: Agriculture Intern
description:
**Revin Krishi – Agriculture Intern** 
  
 



  





**Palakkad, Kerala \| On\-site** 
  
 



  





**About Revin Krishi** 
  
 




 Revin Krishi is an IIT Palakkad\-incubated agritech startup building climate\-smart, data\-driven solutions for farmers and agricultural communities.
 
  
 




 We are looking for an Agriculture Intern interested in agriculture, farmer engagement, field activities, agribusiness, market research, and agritech. The intern will work closely with our team and gain practical exposure to real\-world agricultural challenges and technology\-driven solutions.
 
  
 



  





**Internship Positions Available** 
  
 



 •
 
 Climate\-Smart Agriculture Intern
 
  
 



 •
 
 Agribusiness \& Market Intelligence Intern
 
  
 



 •
 
 Farmer Training \& Capacity Building Intern
 
  
 



 •
 
 Crop Protection (Pest \& Disease) Intern
 
  
 



  





**Role Overview** 
  
 




 As an Agriculture Intern, you will support Revin Krishi's agriculture, field, and community development activities. You will gain hands\-on experience in farmer engagement, field data collection, farmer training, agribusiness, market intelligence, research \& development, and agritech solutions.
 
  
 



  





**What You Will Be Responsible For** 
  
 



 •
 **Farmer Engagement \& Field Visits** 

 – Interact with farmers, understand their requirements, and support field activities.
 
  
 



 •
 **Field Data Collection** 

 – Collect and document crop, farm, and farmer\-related information.
 
  
 



 •
 **Community Development** 

 – Support farmer onboarding, awareness programmes, demonstrations, and 
 





 community activities.
 
  
 



 •
 **Farmer Training \& Capacity Building** 

 – Assist in farmer training sessions and communicate agricultural and technology\-based solutions in simple language.
 
  
 



 •
 **Agribusiness \& Market Intelligence** 

 – Support market research, crop mapping, farmer/FPO research, and 
 





 identification of agricultural opportunities.
 
  
 



 •
 **Agritech Support** 

 – Work with the team on technology\-driven agricultural projects and gather farmer feedback from the field.
 
  
 



  





**Required Skills** 
  
 



 •
 
 Basic understanding of agriculture and farming practices.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Good communication skills in Malayalam.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Comfortable interacting directly with farmers.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Willingness to travel to farms and villages.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Basic digital and technical skills.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Good observation, documentation, and communication skills.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Interest in agribusiness and agricultural market research.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Willingness to learn about Agritech, AI, IoT, climate\-smart agriculture, and digital farming.
 
  
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 
  
 




  
 
 •
 
 B.Sc. Agriculture / B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture / Agricultural Engineering / related agricultural courses.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Freshers and students looking for practical industry and field exposure are welcome.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Candidates with a farming background or interest in farmer engagement will be preferred.
 
  
 



 •
 
 Two\-wheeler and willingness to travel will be an advantage.
 
  
 



  





**Why Join Revin Krishi?** 
  
 




 At Revin Krishi, you will gain practical exposure to agriculture, farmer engagement, agribusiness, field research, market intelligence, and agritech.
 
  
 




 You will work directly with farmers and the Revin team to understand how technology can address real agricultural challenges.
 
  
 




 This internship is an opportunity to take your agricultural knowledge beyond the classroom and apply it in the field with a growing agritech startup.

title: Mechanical Design Engineering - Intern
description:
**Mechanical Design Engineering Intern** 




**Location SATCARD, IIT Palakkad** 




**Duration 4–6 Months** 




**Stipend As per project norms** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineering Intern to contribute to the design, development, assembly, and manufacturing of innovative agricultural implements and machinery. The intern will work closely with the engineering team throughout the complete product development cycle, from concept generation and CAD modeling to fabrication, assembly, testing, and performance evaluation. This internship provides an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in agricultural machinery design, prototype development, manufacturing processes, and engineering validation.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 ● Design agricultural implements and machine components using CAD software.
 



 ● Develop 3D models, assemblies, and detailed manufacturing drawings.
 



 ● Design and optimize mechanical systems for functionality, manufacturability, and costeffectiveness.
 



 ● Perform engineering calculations, including:
 



 ○ Load and stress analysis
 



 ○ Torque and power calculations
 



 ○ Material selection
 



 ○ Factor of Safety (FoS)
 



 ● Prepare fabrication and manufacturing drawings with appropriate GD\&T and tolerances.
 



 ● Support fabrication, machining, welding, and manufacturing activities.
 



 ● Assemble prototypes and troubleshoot mechanical issues during development.
 



 ● Conduct functional testing and performance evaluation of agricultural implements.
 



 ● Assist in design improvements based on testing and field feedback.
 



 ● Coordinate with fabrication teams to ensure design feasibility and quality.
 



 ● Maintain engineering documentation, BOMs, design revisions, and technical reports.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 ● SolidWorks / Fusion 360 / CATIA / Creo
 



 ● Mechanical Design Fundamentals
 



 ● Machine Design
 



 ● Engineering Drawing \& GD\&T
 



 ● CAD Modeling and Assembly Design
 



 ● Basic Manufacturing Processes
 



 ● Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




 ● Agricultural Machinery Design
 



 ● Sheet Metal and Weldment Design
 



 ● Design for Manufacturing (DFM) \& Design for Assembly (DFA)
 



 ● Basic FEA (ANSYS / SolidWorks Simulation)
 



 ● Knowledge of transmission systems, bearings, shafts, gears, chains, and power transmission components ● Prototype development and testing
 



  





**Eligibility** 




 ● B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering
 



 ● Agricultural Engineering
 



 ● Mechatronics Engineering
 



 ● Production Engineering
 



 ● Manufacturing Engineering
 



 ● Final\-year students or recent graduates
 



 ● End\-to\-end product development experience
 



 ● Practical exposure to agricultural machinery design
 



 ● Advanced CAD modeling and engineering drawing skills
 



 ● Prototype fabrication and assembly experience
 



 ● Manufacturing and design validation exposure
 



 ● Engineering testing and performance evaluation
 



 ● Research publication and patent exposure
 



 ● Experience working on real\-world agricultural mechanization projects
 



 ● PCB Design (KiCad / EasyEDA / Altium)
 



 ● ESP32 / STM32 / Arduino Development
 



 ● CAN, UART, I²C, SPI Communication Protocols
 



 ● Battery Management Systems (BMS)
 



 ● Robotics and Automation
 



 ● IoT\-based Monitoring
 



 ● ROS\-compatible hardware integration
 



 ● Basic knowledge of embedded programming (Embedded C/C\+\+)
 



  





**Eligibility** 




 ● B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering
 



 ● Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
 



 ● Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)
 



 ● Mechatronics Engineering
 



 ● Instrumentation Engineering
 



 ● Final\-year students or recent graduates
 



  





**Learning Outcomes** 




 ● Hands\-on experience in agricultural robotics and automation
 



 ● Electrical system design for robotic platforms
 



 ● Power distribution and motor control implementation
 



 ● Sensor integration and hardware interfacing
 



 ● PCB design and prototype development
 



 ● System integration, debugging, and field validation
 



 ● Exposure to research publication and patent development
 



 ● Experience working on real\-world autonomous agricultural machines.

title: Digital Content Creator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Tatvah Agritech is an agritech organization focused on leveraging technology and digital innovation to improve agricultural practices and outcomes. The company works closely with farmers, partners, and stakeholders to enhance productivity, sustainability, and market access in the agricultural sector. Tatvah Agritech values data\-driven decision\-making, clear communication, and practical solutions that directly support farming communities.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Digital Content Creator role based in Kerala, India. The Digital Content Creator will develop and publish engaging content across digital platforms, including websites, social media, blogs, and email campaigns, aligned with Tatvah Agritech’s brand and goals. The role involves collaborating with marketing, product, and field teams to gather insights and stories, optimizing content for reach and engagement, and monitoring performance metrics to refine strategies. The Digital Content Creator is expected to maintain consistent brand voice, uphold quality standards, and support campaigns and initiatives that highlight Tatvah Agritech’s impact.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in digital content creation, including writing, visual storytelling, and basic multimedia production (e.g., image and video editing).
* Ability to plan and execute content strategies for websites, social media, and digital campaigns, with an understanding of audience engagement and branding.
* Comfort with researching agricultural and agritech topics and translating complex information into clear, accessible content for non\-expert audiences.
* Basic knowledge of digital marketing principles, such as social media management, SEO fundamentals, and analytics tools, is beneficial.
* Proficiency with common content and design tools (e.g., CMS platforms, Canva or similar, office productivity software).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in local languages used in Kerala is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines on\-site.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Media, Marketing, Agriculture, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Interest or experience in agriculture, rural development, or technology\-driven solutions for farming communities is a plus.

title: Associate/Intern
description:

* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRMs or LinkedIn research is a plus

 Nice to Have

 How to Apply
